episode_summary: In this episode, Austin Clarence discusses the new Fannie Mae and Freddie Mac rules for condo HOAs and their implications for real estate agents. He explores bridge loans and HELOCs as strategies for buyers to navigate current market conditions. Additionally, Austin provides insights on how geopolitical events are impacting mortgage rates and offers actionable advice for agents to leverage these changes in their business.
